feeds.title: MJBizDaily » New Mexico
feeds.description: MJBiz, the go-to source for cannabis business info since 2011, offers New Mexico cannabis industry news and legislation updates. As a leading publication in the cannabis world, Marijuana Business Daily keeps professionals informed on the latest developments in the industry.

feeds.title: KRQE News 13 » Marijuana
feeds.description: KRQE, based in Albuquerque, stands as a prominent news organization covering New Mexico. With comprehensive over-the-air and online coverage, they deliver breaking, local, and community news, along with weather and sports updates. Producing 52+ hours of original content weekly, they keep audiences informed on the latest cannabis bills and marijuana laws in the state.

feeds.title: ABQ Live
feeds.description: ABQ-Live.com, Albuquerque's premier entertainment source since 2011, offers a comprehensive hub for local events, music, hotspots, and more. As a trusted news, entertainment, and culture platform, ABQ Live delivers the latest breaking news, images, and videos, catering to diverse interests in the community.

feeds.title: Everest Cannabis Co. Blog
feeds.description: Everest Cannabis Co. values community relationships above all, offering an exceptional retail experience. They push boundaries, setting a new standard for dispensaries. Through their blog, customers access insights on cannabis education, products, laws, and events, ensuring informed decisions.

feeds.title: Elevation Cannabis Co. Blog
feeds.description: Elevation Cannabis Co. fosters a community deeply respectful of cannabis, prioritizing quality and education. Since 2018, they've aimed to be a reliable hub for cannabis education. Their Sunland Park Dispensary Blog offers the latest insights and tips, keeping enthusiasts informed as the industry evolves.

feeds.title: GT Dispensary Blog
feeds.description: GT Dispensary offers artisan and craft cannabis products catering to diverse customer needs. Their mission is to deliver clean cannabis selections that enhance customer well-being and meet diverse needs effectively.

feeds.title: Dreamz Dispensary Blog
feeds.description: Dreamz Dispensary offers an immersive experience beyond just cannabis sales. Expert budtenders guide customers, ensuring tailored product selection. With express checkout options, they prioritize convenience. Explore their blog for insights into Dreamz, products, and the New Mexico cannabis industry.

feeds.title: Ultra Health Blog
feeds.description: Ultra Health is committed to delivering top-quality medical-grade cannabis and cannabis-based medicines. Their dispensaries prioritize patient health through education and access to diverse strains, edibles, and concentrates. Stay updated on Ultra Health and medical marijuana news and announcements.

feeds.title: Pecos Valley Production Blog
feeds.description: Pecos Valley Production, nestled in the scenic Pecos Valley, transitions from dairy farming to cannabis with a strong work ethic. Embracing sustainability and equality, they lead the industry while maintaining community connections and promoting responsible consumption. Stay updated on cannabis trends and news via their insightful blog.

feeds.title: The Santa Fe Dispensary Blog
feeds.description: The Santa Fe Dispensary, owned by THE Corp and Picuris Pueblo, draws from ancestral wisdom dating back to the 700s. Inspired by deep heritage and spiritual traditions, they offer modern cannabis products like pre-rolls and topicals. Their blog provides insights and updates for those curious about their dispensary and products.

feeds.title: Bryan's Green Care Blog
feeds.description: Bryan's Green Care, a veteran, minority, woman-owned cannabis dispensary in New Mexico, emphasizes Earth-friendly practices and plant medicines. Led by CEO Roberta Vigil-Bruce and daughter Victoria, they craft herbal-infused products with sustainable ingredients and eco-friendly packaging. Honouring Bryan Grant Bruce's legacy, they strive to share his love and compassion through their brand and company ethos.

feeds.title: Verdes Cannabis Blog
feeds.description: Verdes Cannabis, established in 2010 by Eric and Doug Speegle, boasts over a decade of service in New Mexico. As one of the state's longest-running dispensaries, they prioritize top-quality products and customer satisfaction. Explore Verdes for news, product info, and educational articles, fostering a comprehensive cannabis experience.

feeds.title: High Times » New Mexico
feeds.description: High Times has served as the go-to cannabis resource since 1974, covering cultivation, legalization, entertainment, and more. Comprising journalists, enthusiasts, and entrepreneurs, their commitment lies in connecting people with timely information on cannabis benefits, business, and culture, shaping worldviews and promoting informed perspectives.

feeds.title: The Greenery Room
feeds.description: The Greenery Room prioritizes customer well-being with access to premium cannabis products and rigorous quality standards. Their knowledgeable team ensures a tailored experience, recognizing diverse preferences and needs. Born from a belief in cannabis's potential, they offer a gateway to new possibilities.

feeds.title: Betty Nugz Blog
feeds.description: Betty Nugz, a licensed delivery-only cannabis dispensary in Santa Fe, prioritizes personal wellness through convenient delivery. With a friendly, vetted crew and high-quality products, they ensure a trustworthy experience. Established in 2021, they serve both medical and recreational clients as a third-party cannabis transportation service provider statewide.
